fundamental.summary: PLD shows minimal fundamental conviction with no insider activity, institutional signals, government contracts, lobbying spend, or retail interest as of 2022-05-31.

sentiment.congressional_conviction: medium — small to medium amounts, junior/mid-tier members
sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (VIX-equivalent 12) presents contrarian buy opportunity; modest congressional buying by Democratic representatives 140+ days ago lacks recent conviction; no news data to confirm sentiment.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (361), flat yield curve signals recession risk, and real estate sector faces credit stress in tightening environment despite falling dollar tailwind.

debate.key_bull_argument: ADX 42.93 confirms strong trend structure with three white soldiers and 15x volume spike, while extreme fear sentiment (VIX 361) and contrarian buy signal present classic capitulation entry opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price remains below EMA-21, SMA-21, and Ichimoku cloud with negative CMF and AO; macro environment is severely unfavourable (crisis VIX, flat yield curve, high credit spreads); and fundamental conviction is absent, making this a momentum trap in a deteriorating risk backdrop.
